name: Saraswati Namastubhyam
text:
सरस्वति नमस्तुभ्यं वरदे कामरूपिणि ।
विद्यारम्भं करिष्यामि सिद्धिर्भवतु मे सदा ॥
meaning: I bow to Saraswati, giver of blessings. As I begin learning, may my efforts come to fruition.
purpose: A prayer before study and creative learning.
supports: Focus; memory; expression; confidence in learning.
when: Before reading, writing, music, study or an examination.
